items.title: The Incomplete Theory
items.question: EPR (1935) argued quantum mechanics must be incomplete: measuring one particle instantly fixes another's property without touching it. What did they claim must exist?
items.correctExplanation: Hidden elements of reality — definite properties existing pre-measurement: incompleteness, not spookiness, was EPR's charge. Reality before observation.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is hidden elements of reality. Signals, minds, and worlds miss it: Einstein demanded pre-existing values for predictable outcomes. Completeness required more variables.
items.lessonContent:
Predictability demands pre-existing values.
Completeness requires hidden variables.
Reality before observation: the demand.
Incompleteness charges, never mysticism.
Share this: demand one hidden variable.

items.title: The Contextual Reply
items.question: Bohr answered EPR by insisting quantum phenomena include the experimental arrangement essentially. What can't be separated?
items.correctExplanation: Object and apparatus — phenomena are wholes including measurement context: no property-talk without setup-talk. Context constitutes outcomes.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is object and apparatus. Mind, time, and duality miss it: Bohr's indivisibility joins system with instruments. Arrangements co-author results.
items.lessonContent:
Arrangements co-author all results.
Indivisibility joins systems with instruments.
Context constitutes quantum outcomes.
Property-talk needs setup-talk always.
Share this: include one apparatus tonight.

items.title: The Two Bound
items.question: CHSH inequalities cap classical correlations at 2; quantum mechanics predicts violations up to a specific higher ceiling. What is quantum's maximum?
items.correctExplanation: Two root two (≈2.828) — Tsirelson bound: quantum correlations exceed classical but stop here. Ceilings stratify theories.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is two root two. Decimals, threes, and fours miss it: 2√2 caps quantum, 4 awaits superquantum PR boxes. Bounds separate classical, quantum, beyond.
items.lessonContent:
Bounds separate theory classes cleanly.
Ceilings stratify classical-quantum-beyond.
2.828 caps quantum correlations.
Violations have their own limits.
Share this: bound one correlation tonight.

items.title: The Superquantum Box
items.question: Popescu-Rohrlich boxes reach CHSH 4 — beyond quantum's 2.83 — while still forbidding signals. What do they prove possible?
items.correctExplanation: Stronger-than-quantum nonlocality — no-signaling allows correlations quantum mechanics never reaches. QM is nonlocal, but not maximally so.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is stronger-than-quantum nonlocality. Messages, motors, and time machines miss it: PR boxes obey no-signaling while out-correlating quanta. Quantum is a waypoint, not the summit.
items.lessonContent:
Waypoints differ from summits always.
No-signaling allows superquantum correlations.
Quantum nonlocality isn't maximal.
Boxes beyond theory exist mathematically.
Share this: imagine one PR box.

items.title: The Silent Correlation
items.question: Entangled measurements correlate perfectly, yet no message can ride them. What mathematical fact enforces silence?
items.correctExplanation: Marginal randomness — each side alone sees pure noise regardless of distant settings: signals need controllable differences. Randomness guards causality.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is marginal outcome randomness. Speeds, intensities, and distances miss it: local statistics ignore remote choices completely. Noise locally, pattern jointly — silence guaranteed.
items.lessonContent:
Local noise guards global causality.
Statistics ignore remote choices fully.
Signals need controllable differences.
Randomness protects cause-effect order.
Share this: hear one silent correlation.

items.title: The Switching Proof
items.question: Aspect's 1982 experiment switched analyzer settings while photons were already in flight. What loophole did switching target?
items.correctExplanation: Setting predetermination — switching mid-flight blocks conspiracies set at emission: choices postdate departures. Timing closes communication loopholes.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is setting predetermination. Efficiency, absorption, and drift miss it: in-flight switching severs past coordination. Late choices guarantee fresh independence.
items.lessonContent:
Late choices guarantee independence fully.
Switching severs past coordination.
Timing closes communication loopholes.
Mid-flight changes outrun conspiracies.
Share this: switch one setting late.

items.title: The Closed Loopholes
items.question: The 2015 experiments (Delft, NIST, Vienna) are called loophole-free. Which pair did they close together?
items.correctExplanation: Detection and locality — efficient detectors plus spacelike separation closed both classic escapes at once. Loopholes shut jointly, finally.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is detection and locality. Gravity, funding, and math miss it: fair-sampling assumptions died with 90%+ efficiencies while spacelike gaps blocked signals. 2015 ended the main evasions.
items.lessonContent:
Efficiencies kill fair-sampling excuses.
Spacelike gaps block signal stories.
Joint closure ended main evasions.
2015 settled decades of debate.
Share this: close one loophole firmly.

items.title: The Cosmic Settings
items.question: Cosmic Bell tests chose analyzer settings using ancient quasar photons — predating Earth itself. What does stellar randomness buy?
items.correctExplanation: Freedom-of-choice assurance — quasar-set choices predate any earthly conspiracy by billions of years. Cosmic independence dwarfs laboratory loopholes.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is freedom-of-choice assurance. Brightness, cost, and speed miss it: billion-year-old photons can't conspire with tabletop events. Settings from stars defeat earthly plots.
items.lessonContent:
Billion-year photons can't conspire locally.
Stellar randomness dwarfs lab loopholes.
Independence needs cosmic timescales.
Settings from stars defeat plots.
Share this: choose by quasar tonight.

items.title: The Final Loophole
items.question: Superdeterminism saves locality by proposing the universe conspired from the Big Bang: settings, particles, experimenters all pre-correlated. What makes it untestable?
items.correctExplanation: Ruling out independence — superdeterminism denies the free-choice assumption every test needs: conspiracies all the way down. Unfalsifiable by construction.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is ruling out independence itself. Complexity, cost, and language miss it: denying independent settings voids all experimental logic. Conspiracy theories of everything explain nothing testably.
items.lessonContent:
Conspiracies all the way down explain nothing.
Independence assumptions underlie all tests.
Unfalsifiable constructions convince nobody.
Denying premises voids conclusions.
Share this: assume one independence.

items.title: The Triple All-or-Nothing
items.question: GHZ states produce perfect contradictions with local realism in single runs — no statistics needed. What makes three particles stronger than two?
items.correctExplanation: All-or-nothing contradiction — GHZ predictions clash with local realism case-by-case: single runs refute. Statistics unnecessary at three.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is all-or-nothing contradiction. Energies, brightness, and magnets miss it: triple entanglement yields logical, not statistical, impossibility. One run suffices where thousands were needed.
items.lessonContent:
Single runs refute at three particles.
Logic replaces statistics here fully.
Triple entanglement tightens paradoxes.
All-or-nothing beats almost-always.
Share this: contradict once, perfectly.

items.title: The Nine Percent
items.question: Hardy's paradox derives nonlocality from events occurring just ~9% of the time — no inequalities, minimal assumptions. What powers this lean proof?
items.correctExplanation: Logical contradiction in rare cases — Hardy's setup makes local realism self-contradictory on a small fraction: quality over quantity. Nine percent suffices logically.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is logical contradiction in rare cases. Counts, labs, and speed miss it: a slender contradiction class defeats local realism outright. Leanness is the achievement.
items.lessonContent:
Slender contradictions defeat giants fully.
Quality outranks quantity in proofs.
Nine percent suffices logically here.
Leanness is the real achievement.
Share this: contradict leanly once.

items.title: The Destroyed Original
items.question: Quantum teleportation transfers a qubit's state using entanglement plus two classical bits — while the original is necessarily destroyed. Why must it die?
items.correctExplanation: No-cloning forbids copies: transfer requires erasure at the source. Teleportation moves, never duplicates.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is the no-cloning theorem. Energy, patents, and taste miss it: unknown quantum states cannot be copied, only relocated. Destruction is the price of transmission.
items.lessonContent:
Transmission prices destruction here.
Copies forbidden; relocations allowed.
Unknown states never duplicate.
Erasure funds every transfer.
Share this: move, never copy, once.

items.title: The Stranger Bond
items.question: Two independent entangled pairs can project their outer particles into mutual entanglement — though those two never interacted. What is this?
items.correctExplanation: Entanglement swapping — Bell-measuring middles entangles outers retroactively in effect: strangers bonded through intermediaries. Meeting unnecessary for union.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is entanglement swapping. Dating, matchmaking, and pals miss it: middle measurement projects outers into entanglement. Interaction histories don't bound unions.
items.lessonContent:
Middles mediate stranger unions fully.
Interaction histories never bound bonds.
Projections entangle the unmet ever.
Meeting unnecessary for union here.
Share this: bond two strangers tonight.

items.title: The Retroactive Bond
items.question: Peres noted experimenters can decide AFTER detection whether distant particles had been entangled. What does delayed choice govern?
items.correctExplanation: Past entanglement — later measurements define earlier entanglement status: histories hinge on present choices. Retroactivity without signaling.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is past entanglement. Temperatures, colors, and humidity miss it: delayed-choice swapping makes entanglement history-dependent. Present choices author past bonds.
items.lessonContent:
Present choices author past bonds.
Histories hinge on later measurements.
Retroactivity needs no signaling ever.
Delayed decisions define prior unions.
Share this: author one past bond.

items.title: The Faithful Qubit
items.question: A qubit maximally entangled with one partner cannot entangle with any other. What limits quantum sharing?
items.correctExplanation: Monogamy of entanglement — maximal bonds exclude thirds: Coffman-Kundu-Wootters quantified faithfulness. Sharing dilutes maximality.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is monogamy of entanglement. Shyness, budgets, and loyalty miss it: entanglement budgets split, never duplicate. Maximal with one means minimal with others.
items.lessonContent:
Maximal bonds exclude all thirds.
Budgets split, never duplicate here.
Faithfulness quantifies mathematically ever.
Sharing dilutes maximality strictly.
Share this: honor one maximal bond.

items.title: The Purified Pairs
items.question: Many noisy entangled pairs can be processed into fewer pure singlets via local operations plus classical chat. What is this purification?
items.correctExplanation: Entanglement distillation — LOCC concentrates diffuse entanglement into pure form: many mixed yield few pristine. Purification through protocol.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is entanglement distillation. Laundry, filtering, and complaining miss it: local operations plus classical communication squeeze purity from noise. Protocols purify what nature dilutes.
items.lessonContent:
Protocols purify what nature dilutes.
Local plus classical concentrates purity.
Many mixed yield few pristine.
Distillation rescues noisy bonds.
Share this: distill one pure pair.

items.title: The Locked Bonds
items.question: Some entangled states can never be distilled to pure singlets, however many copies gather. What are these frustrating states?
items.correctExplanation: Bound entanglement — entangled yet undistillable: Horodecki's locked resources resist purification. Entangled does not imply useful.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is bound entanglement. Samples, looseness, and spares miss it: PPT states bind entanglement unusably. Locked bonds tease without paying.
items.lessonContent:
Locked bonds tease without paying.
Entangled never implies useful directly.
Copies accumulate, purity refuses.
Frustration has a technical name.
Share this: accept one locked bond.

items.title: The Tested Secret
items.question: Ekert's 1991 protocol secures keys by testing Bell violations during the exchange itself. What guarantees secrecy against spies?
items.correctExplanation: Bell-test failure for spies — eavesdropping degrades violations detectably: tested secrecy, not assumed. Violations vouch.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is Bell-test failure for spies. Passwords, envelopes, and alarms miss it: interception disturbs Bell statistics observably. Testing during exchange exposes listeners.
items.lessonContent:
Interception disturbs statistics observably.
Tested secrecy beats assumed safety.
Violations vouch for privacy directly.
Exchanges test while transmitting.
Share this: test one secret channel.

items.title: The Untrusted Box
items.question: Device-independent cryptography trusts neither the devices nor their vendor — only observed statistics. What vouches for security?
items.correctExplanation: Bell violation itself — statistics certify secrecy regardless of hardware honesty: black boxes proven by numbers. Trust nothing, verify everything.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is Bell violation itself. Brands, celebrities, and warranties miss it: observed violations bound eavesdropper knowledge device-independently. Numbers vouch where vendors cannot.
items.lessonContent:
Numbers vouch where vendors cannot.
Statistics certify regardless of hardware.
Trust nothing; verify everything here.
Black boxes proven by violations.
Share this: distrust one device usefully.

items.title: The Doubled Message
items.question: Sharing one entangled pair lets a sender transmit two classical bits by shipping a single qubit. What doubles channel capacity?
items.correctExplanation: Superdense coding — pre-shared entanglement doubles classical capacity per qubit: two bits ride one particle. Sharing multiplies sending.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is superdense coding. Envelopes, couriers, and volume miss it: entanglement pre-loads channel capacity. One qubit carries two bits when pairs pre-share.
items.lessonContent:
Pre-sharing multiplies sending capacity.
One qubit carries two bits here.
Entanglement preloads channels fully.
Doubling needs prior sharing.
Share this: share before sending once.

items.title: The Wormhole Whisper
items.question: Maldacena and Susskind conjectured wormholes and entanglement as two descriptions of single reality. What does ER=EPR propose?
items.correctExplanation: Geometry equals entanglement — ER bridges are EPR correlations geometrized: spacetime woven from quantum bonds. Conjecture, not doctrine.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is geometry equals entanglement. Travel, vanishing, and repulsion miss it: the conjecture unifies spacetime with information. Whispers, not theorems, currently.
items.lessonContent:
Conjectures unify before proving fully.
Spacetime weaves from quantum bonds.
Bridges equal correlations here maybe.
Whispers precede theorems in physics.
Share this: whisper one unification.

items.title: The Horizon Firewall
items.question: AMPS argued entanglement monogamy plus equivalence principle forces high-energy drama at black hole horizons. What burns infallers in this paradox?
items.correctExplanation: Firewall conjecture — monogamy forbids triple entanglement (early radiation, late radiation, interior): something must give, perhaps smooth horizons. Paradoxes burn assumptions.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is firewall conjecture. Radiation, flares, and dragons miss it: AMPS forces choosing between equivalence and monogamy. Horizons host contradictions, not just heat.
items.lessonContent:
Contradictions host at horizons fully.
Monogamy battles equivalence here.
Something must give: smoothness or unitarity.
Paradoxes burn assumptions first.
Share this: fall past one paradox.

items.title: The Boundary Secret
items.question: Ground-state entanglement typically scales with boundary area rather than volume. What does this imply for simulating quantum matter?
items.correctExplanation: Tractable descriptions — area laws tame exponential Hilbert spaces: tensor networks exploit boundary scaling. Simulation survives via geometry.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is tractable descriptions. Impossibility, infinity, and mail miss it: area-law states compress efficiently. Boundaries bound complexity.
items.lessonContent:
Boundaries bound complexity kindly here.
Area laws tame exponential spaces.
Tractable survives via geometry fully.
Ground states compress efficiently.
Share this: bound one complexity.

items.title: The Joint Reading
items.question: Teleportation's crucial joint operation projects two qubits onto entangled bases together. What measurement enables the transfer?
items.correctExplanation: Bell measurement — joint entangled-basis readout teleports states: two qubits read as one Bell pair. Reading together transfers apart.
items.incorrectExplanation: Not quite — the answer is Bell measurement. Temperatures, passwords, and weights miss it: projecting onto Bell states moves quantum information. Joint readings enable distant transfers.
items.lessonContent:
Joint readings enable distant transfers.
Two read as one Bell pair.
Projections move information wholly.
Reading together transfers apart.
Share this: read jointly once tonight.

items.title: The Classical Chaperone
items.question: Why must teleportation send two classical bits alongside its entanglement?
items.correctExplanation: Causality guard — classical bits cap transfer at light speed: entanglement alone signals nothing. Chaperones enforce cosmic speed limits.
items.incorrectExplanation: Actually, the answer is causality guard. Tradition, paperwork, and spares miss it: without classical accompaniment, instant transfer would violate relativity. Bits brake quanta lawfully.
items.lessonContent:
Bits brake quanta lawfully always.
Chaperones enforce speed limits fully.
Classical accompanies quantum duly.
Causality guards all transfers here.
Share this: chaperone one transfer.
